statement:
For every unit_1 and every word:
  when unit_1 declares the word and is not a term, the word is declared in a unit that is not a term.
formula: all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Introduce.rel and u not in Term) implies w in Misplaced
answer: all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Introduce.rel and u not in Term) implies w in Misplaced

statement:
All of these hold:
  - checker reports the formula of a unit as lone on a signature when all of these hold:
      - the unit holds a formula
      - the unit is not a term
      - no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit
  - for every unit and every word:
      when checker reports the formula of the unit as lone on the word, no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit.
formula: (all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)) and (all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged)
answer: (all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)) and (all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged)

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  when pass_1 puts a time phrase in front of the words it covers and pass_2 says a few clauses as one sentence, pass_1 runs before pass_2.
formula: all a: TimePhraseInFront, b: ClausesInASentence | a->b in ahead
answer: all a: TimePhraseInFront, b: ClausesInASentence | a->b in ahead

statement:
For every word_1:
  checker reports the word word_1 when at least one of these holds:
    - word_1 is said by a reading and declared by nothing
    - word_1 is declared in a unit that is not a term
    - the reading of word_1 is in another unit than its declaration
    - no claim, definition or fact uses word_1
formula: all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged
answer: all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2, every unit_1, every unit_2 and every word:
  checker does not report the formula of unit_1 as lone on the word when all of these hold:
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_1 holds unit_1
    - document_2 holds unit_2
    - a block of unit_2 names the word outside its declaration
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (d->e in Context.rel and d->u in Hold.units and e->v in Hold.units and v->w in Utter.rel) implies u->w not in Expose.rel
answer: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (d->e in Context.rel and d->u in Hold.units and e->v in Hold.units and v->w in Utter.rel) implies u->w not in Expose.rel

statement:
Verbalizer says the second side of a list before its first side when all of these hold:
  - the list is a rule whose first side is a run of clauses said as bullets
  - the list is a rule whose second side is one line with no time phrase, relative clause, comma or "when"
  - the list is not a rule with an "otherwise"
formula: all f: Series | (f in ListFirstSide and f in PlainSecondSide and f not in Otherwise) implies f in SecondSideFirst
answer: all f: Series | (f in ListFirstSide and f in PlainSecondSide and f not in Otherwise) implies f in SecondSideFirst

statement:
For every plugin, every document and every listing frontmatter:
  when the document starts with the listing frontmatter and the listing frontmatter lists the plugin, checker runs the plugin over the document.
formula: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and lists[f, p]) implies p->d in Over.rel
answer: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and lists[f, p]) implies p->d in Over.rel

statement: When the statement of a unit is current, checker does not write the statement of the unit when it generates.
formula: all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Rewritten
answer: all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Rewritten

statement:
Verbalizer says a list as bullets when all of these hold:
  - the list has an item that holds a comma
  - the list has more than two clauses
formula: all f: Series | (f in CommaItem and f in MoreThanTwo) implies f in AsBullets
answer: all f: Series | (f in CommaItem and f in MoreThanTwo) implies f in AsBullets

statement:
The checker cannot read a frontmatter when at least one of these holds:
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of an entry that starts with an at sign outside quotes
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a key that neither the checker nor a plugin that the frontmatter lists defines
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a list that is not closed
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a string that is not closed
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a key that appears twice
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a path that names no document
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of an extension that leads back to its own document
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a setting in a document that is not the entry document
formula: all f: Frontmatter | (f in Misquoted or f in Foreign or f in Unclosed or f in Unterminated or f in Doubled or f in Dangling or f in Looping or f in Stray) implies f in Refused
answer: all f: Frontmatter | (f in Misquoted or f in Foreign or f in Unclosed or f in Unterminated or f in Doubled or f in Dangling or f in Looping or f in Stray) implies f in Refused

statement:
For every fence and every unit:
  when the fence names a language and lies in the own text of the unit, checker reads the fence as a block of the unit.
formula: all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel
answer: all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel

statement:
For every unit_1 and every unit_2:
  checker names unit_2 in its report of a contradiction when all of these hold:
    - unit_1 is held with units that cannot all hold
    - the analyzer is asked about unit_1 together with unit_2
formula: all u: Unit, v: Unit | (u in Contradicting and u->v in Together.rel) implies v in Named
answer: all u: Unit, v: Unit | (u in Contradicting and u->v in Together.rel) implies v in Named

statement:
When a search leaves one unit out
then there is exactly one unit_1 such that all of these hold:
       - the search leaves out unit_1
       - the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of unit_1
       - the search does not require unit_1 to hold
       - for every unit_2:
           the search requires unit_2 to hold when all of these hold:
             - the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of unit_2
             - unit_2 and unit_1 are different
formula: all s: Search | s in Trial implies (one u: Unit | s->u in Leave.rel and u in Held and s->u not in Pose.units and (all v: Unit | (v in Held and v != u) implies s->v in Pose.units))
answer: all s: Search | s in Trial implies (one u: Unit | s->u in Leave.rel and u in Held and s->u not in Pose.units and (all v: Unit | (v in Held and v != u) implies s->v in Pose.units))

statement:
For every plugin, every document and every listing frontmatter:
  checker does not run the plugin over the document when all of these hold:
    - the document starts with the listing frontmatter
    - the listing frontmatter does not list the plugin
    - the command line of no run names the document
formula: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and not lists[f, p] and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
answer: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and not lists[f, p] and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel

statement:
For every plugin, every document and every listing frontmatter:
  checker does not run the plugin over the document when all of these hold:
    - the document starts with the listing frontmatter
    - the listing frontmatter holds no entry
    - the command line of no run names the document
formula: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel) and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
answer: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel) and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel

statement:
All of these hold:
  - when the verbalizer fails on the formula of a unit with a fault of its own, checker does not say why the formula of the unit cannot be said
  - for every run, every command_1 and every unit:
      the run does not exit with code 0 when all of these hold:
        - the run asks for command_1
        - command_1 is the command `generate` or is the command `check`
        - the verbalizer fails on the formula of the unit with a fault of its own
formula: (all u: Unit | u in Faulted implies u not in Explained) and (all r: Run, c: Command, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and (c in GenerateCommand or c in CheckCommand) and u in Faulted) implies r not in Exits0)
answer: (all u: Unit | u in Faulted implies u not in Explained) and (all r: Run, c: Command, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and (c in GenerateCommand or c in CheckCommand) and u in Faulted) implies r not in Exits0)

statement: When a definition has an alternative that says something about another unit, verbalizer says the definition as a list of the alternatives as they stand.
formula: all f: Definition | f in NotAboutSubject implies f in AsItStands
answer: all f: Definition | f in NotAboutSubject implies f in AsItStands

statement:
For every unit:
  all of these hold:
    - the statement of the unit is current when all of these hold:
        - the unit holds a formula
        - the statement of the unit sits between the markers of a generated region
        - the statement of the unit does not differ from what its formula says
        - the formula of the unit can be said in words
        - the statement of the unit reads back as its formula alone
    - when the unit holds no formula, the statement of the unit is not current
formula: all u: Unit | ((u in Logical and u in Generated and u not in Differs and u not in Unsayable and u not in Misread) implies u in Current) and (u not in Logical implies u not in Current)
answer: all u: Unit | ((u in Logical and u in Generated and u not in Differs and u not in Unsayable and u not in Misread) implies u in Current) and (u not in Logical implies u not in Current)

statement:
For every run and every logic command:
  the run exits with code 0 when all of these hold:
    - the run asks for the logic command
    - there is no scenario such that checker reports that the scenario cannot happen
    - no unit is held with units that cannot all hold
formula: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and (no x: Scenario | x in Raised) and (no u: Unit | u in Contradicting)) implies r in Exits0
answer: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and (no x: Scenario | x in Raised) and (no u: Unit | u in Contradicting)) implies r in Exits0

statement:
For every document and every unit:
  checker reports the statement of the unit when all of these hold:
    - the document keeps readings
    - the document holds the unit
    - the unit holds a formula
    - the statement of the unit is not current
formula: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
answer: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  pass_1 runs before pass_2 when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says until and since of two clauses as one sentence
    - pass_2 puts a time phrase in front of the words it covers
formula: all a: UntilInASentence, b: TimePhraseInFront | a->b in ahead
answer: all a: UntilInASentence, b: TimePhraseInFront | a->b in ahead

statement:
For every run, every generate command and every unit:
  when the run asks for the generate command and the statement of the unit is handwritten, checker reports the statement of the unit and the run does not exit with code 0.
formula: all r: Run, c: GenerateCommand, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and u in Handwritten) implies (u in Reported and r not in Exits0)
answer: all r: Run, c: GenerateCommand, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and u in Handwritten) implies (u in Reported and r not in Exits0)

statement:
For every run:
  all of these hold:
    - when the run gets code 2 from a plugin, the run exits with code 2
    - the run exits with code 1 when all of these hold:
        - the run gets code 1 from a plugin
        - the run gets code 2 from no plugin
        - checker does not stop the run itself
formula: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2) and (((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1)
answer: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2) and (((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1)

statement:
Verbalizer says a list without "then" when all of these hold:
  - the list is a rule whose two sides are each one clause
  - the list is not a rule whose first side begins with a time phrase
  - the list is not a rule whose second side begins with a time phrase
formula: all f: Series | (f in OneLineRule and f not in TimeFirst and f not in TimeSecond) implies f in DropsThen
answer: all f: Series | (f in OneLineRule and f not in TimeFirst and f not in TimeSecond) implies f in DropsThen

statement:
For every unit_1 and every unit_2:
  when unit_1 shares a word with unit_2, the analyzer is asked about unit_1 together with unit_2.
formula: all u: Unit, v: Unit | u->v in Share.rel implies u->v in Together.rel
answer: all u: Unit, v: Unit | u->v in Share.rel implies u->v in Together.rel

statement:
A run exits with code 2 when at least one of these holds:
  - there is a frontmatter that lists a missing plugin
  - there is a document such that checker reports that the document has a frontmatter it cannot read
  - the run asks for a command that is not available
  - the run gets code 2 from a plugin
formula: all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
answer: all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2

statement:
For every run and every command_1:
  when the run asks for command_1 and command_1 is not available, checker reports command_1 as an unknown command.
formula: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown
answer: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown

statement:
Verbalizer says a list with "then" before the time phrase when all of these hold:
  - the list is a rule whose two sides are each one clause
  - the list is not a rule whose first side begins with a time phrase
  - the list is a rule whose second side begins with a time phrase
formula: all f: Series | (f in OneLineRule and f not in TimeFirst and f in TimeSecond) implies f in KeepsThen
answer: all f: Series | (f in OneLineRule and f not in TimeFirst and f in TimeSecond) implies f in KeepsThen

statement:
A run exits with code 1 when all of these hold:
  - the run gets code 1 from a plugin
  - the run gets code 2 from no plugin
  - checker does not stop the run itself
formula: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1
answer: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1

statement:
For every word_1:
  checker does not report the word word_1 when all of these hold:
    - word_1 is said by no reading or is declared
    - word_1 is not declared in a unit that is not a term
    - the reading of word_1 is in the unit of its declaration
    - a claim, a definition or a fact uses word_1
formula: all w: Word | (w not in Undeclared and w not in Misplaced and w not in Apart and w not in Unused) implies w not in Flagged
answer: all w: Word | (w not in Undeclared and w not in Misplaced and w not in Apart and w not in Unused) implies w not in Flagged

statement: When a list is longer than a line when it is put in a sentence, verbalizer says the list as bullets.
formula: all f: Series | f in TooLong implies f in AsBullets
answer: all f: Series | f in TooLong implies f in AsBullets

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  pass_1 runs before pass_2 when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a set equal to a variable as that variable and no other
    - pass_2 makes nested quantifiers of "for every" one
formula: all a: XAndNoOther, b: ForEveryTogether | a->b in ahead
answer: all a: XAndNoOther, b: ForEveryTogether | a->b in ahead

statement: When project has a tracker and a bug names no issue, checker reports an untracking for the bug.
formula: all b: Bug | (some Tracker and (no i: Issue | b->i in Name.issue)) implies b in Untracking
answer: all b: Bug | (some Tracker and (no i: Issue | b->i in Name.issue)) implies b in Untracking

statement:
The statement of a unit is handwritten when all of these hold:
  - the unit holds a formula
  - the unit has a statement
  - the statement of the unit does not sit between the markers of a generated region
  - the formula of the unit can be said in words
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Stated and u not in Generated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Handwritten
answer: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Stated and u not in Generated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Handwritten

statement: When a fence names a language and has no second word that names a role, the fence has the role of the formula of its unit.
formula: all f: Fence | (f in Languaged and f in NoSecondWord) implies f in UnitBlock
answer: all f: Fence | (f in Languaged and f in NoSecondWord) implies f in UnitBlock

statement:
The formula of a unit cannot be said in words when at least one of these holds:
  - the formula of the unit names a word that has no reading
  - the unit holds more than one formula
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) implies u in Unsayable
answer: all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) implies u in Unsayable

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  pass_1 runs before pass_2 when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a rule at every later moment as "from now on, whenever"
    - pass_2 says the second side of a rule before its first side
formula: all a: FromNowOnWhenever, b: ClaimFirst | a->b in ahead
answer: all a: FromNowOnWhenever, b: ClaimFirst | a->b in ahead

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2 and every unit:
  the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of the unit when all of these hold:
    - the project lists document_1 among the documents it checks
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_2 holds the unit
    - the unit holds a formula with no keyword
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit | (d in Checked and d->e in Context.rel and e->u in Hold.units and u in BareFormula) implies u in Held
answer: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit | (d in Checked and d->e in Context.rel and e->u in Hold.units and u in BareFormula) implies u in Held

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2, every unit_1, every unit_2 and every word:
  the word is said by no reading or is declared when all of these hold:
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_1 holds unit_1
    - a reading in unit_1 says the word
    - document_2 holds unit_2
    - unit_2 declares the word
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (d->e in Context.rel and d->u in Hold.units and u->w in Voice.rel and e->v in Hold.units and v->w in Introduce.rel) implies w not in Undeclared
answer: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (d->e in Context.rel and d->u in Hold.units and u->w in Voice.rel and e->v in Hold.units and v->w in Introduce.rel) implies w not in Undeclared

statement:
The statement of a unit is unwritten when all of these hold:
  - the unit holds a formula
  - the unit has no statement
  - the formula of the unit can be said in words
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Stated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Unwritten
answer: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Stated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Unwritten

statement:
A run exits with code 0 when all of these hold:
  - there is no plugin such that the run gets code 1 from the plugin or gets code 2 from the plugin
  - checker does not stop the run itself
formula: all r: Run | ((no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1 or r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits0
answer: all r: Run | ((no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1 or r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits0

statement:
For every run and every logic command:
  the run does not exit with code 0 when all of these hold:
    - the run asks for the logic command
    - at least one of these holds:
        - there is a scenario such that checker reports that the scenario cannot happen
        - there is a unit that is held with units that cannot all hold
formula: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and ((some x: Scenario | x in Raised) or (some u: Unit | u in Contradicting))) implies r not in Exits0
answer: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and ((some x: Scenario | x in Raised) or (some u: Unit | u in Contradicting))) implies r not in Exits0

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  when pass_1 moves a negation inward and pass_2 says a quantifier as a noun phrase, pass_1 runs before pass_2.
formula: all a: NegationInward, b: NounPhrases | a->b in ahead
answer: all a: NegationInward, b: NounPhrases | a->b in ahead

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  when pass_1 says a few clauses as one sentence and pass_2 says the second side of a rule before its first side, pass_1 runs before pass_2.
formula: all a: ClausesInASentence, b: ClaimFirst | a->b in ahead
answer: all a: ClausesInASentence, b: ClaimFirst | a->b in ahead

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  pass_1 runs before pass_2 when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a few clauses as one sentence
    - pass_2 says the subject and the verb that negative clauses share once, before "none of these"
formula: all a: ClausesInASentence, b: NoneOfThese | a->b in ahead
answer: all a: ClausesInASentence, b: NoneOfThese | a->b in ahead

statement:
For every scenario and every unit:
  checker names the unit in its report of the scenario when all of these hold:
    - checker reports that the scenario cannot happen
    - leaving out the unit lets the scenario happen
formula: all c: Scenario, u: Unit | (c in Raised and u->c in Frees.rel) implies c->u in Blame.rel
answer: all c: Scenario, u: Unit | (c in Raised and u->c in Frees.rel) implies c->u in Blame.rel

statement:
For every unit_1, every unit_2 and every word:
  checker does not report the formula of unit_1 as lone on the word when all of these hold:
    - unit_2 and unit_1 are different
    - a block of unit_2 names the word outside its declaration
formula: all u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (v != u and v->w in Utter.rel) implies u->w not in Expose.rel
answer: all u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (v != u and v->w in Utter.rel) implies u->w not in Expose.rel

statement:
For every document, every unit and every word:
  when the document keeps no readings and holds the unit, checker does not report the formula of the unit as lone on the word.
formula: all d: Document, u: Unit, w: Word | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies u->w not in Expose.rel
answer: all d: Document, u: Unit, w: Word | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies u->w not in Expose.rel

statement:
A word is said by a reading and declared by nothing when all of these hold:
  - there is a unit_1 such that a reading in unit_1 says the word
  - no unit declares the word
formula: all w: Word | ((some u: Unit | u->w in Voice.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel)) implies w in Undeclared
answer: all w: Word | ((some u: Unit | u->w in Voice.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel)) implies w in Undeclared

statement:
For every unit and every signature:
  checker reports the formula of the unit as lone on the signature when all of these hold:
    - the unit holds a formula
    - the unit is not a term
    - the formula of the unit is lone on the signature
formula: all u: Unit, w: Signature | (u in Logical and u not in Term and loneOn[u, w]) implies u->w in Expose.rel
answer: all u: Unit, w: Signature | (u in Logical and u not in Term and loneOn[u, w]) implies u->w in Expose.rel

statement:
The statement of a unit is stale when all of these hold:
  - the unit holds a formula
  - the statement of the unit sits between the markers of a generated region
  - the statement of the unit differs from what its formula says
  - the formula of the unit can be said in words
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Generated and u in Differs and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Stale
answer: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Generated and u in Differs and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Stale

statement:
For every search, every scenario and every unit_1:
  the author asks about leaving out unit_1 for the scenario when all of these hold:
    - the search leaves one unit out
    - the search requires the scenario to happen
    - the search leaves out unit_1
    - there is a unit_2 such that the author asks about leaving out unit_2 for the scenario
formula: all s: Search, c: Scenario, u: Unit | (s in Trial and s->c in Pose.scenario and s->u in Leave.rel and (some v: Unit | c->v in Probe.rel)) implies c->u in Probe.rel
answer: all s: Search, c: Scenario, u: Unit | (s in Trial and s->c in Pose.scenario and s->u in Leave.rel and (some v: Unit | c->v in Probe.rel)) implies c->u in Probe.rel

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  pass_1 runs before pass_2 when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a quantifier as a noun phrase
    - pass_2 says a quantifier of its variable alone as "there is a … that"
formula: all a: NounPhrases, b: ThereIsAThat | a->b in ahead
answer: all a: NounPhrases, b: ThereIsAThat | a->b in ahead

statement:
For every unit_1 and every word:
  the reading of the word is in another unit than its declaration when all of these hold:
    - a reading in unit_1 says the word
    - a unit declares the word
    - unit_1 does not declare the word
formula: all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Voice.rel and (some v: Unit | v->w in Introduce.rel) and u->w not in Introduce.rel) implies w in Apart
answer: all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Voice.rel and (some v: Unit | v->w in Introduce.rel) and u->w not in Introduce.rel) implies w in Apart

statement:
For every document and every unit:
  checker reports the statement of the unit when all of these hold:
    - the document keeps readings
    - the document holds the unit
    - the unit holds a formula
    - the statement of the unit is not current
formula: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
answer: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported

statement:
Checker reports an orphaning for a unit when all of these hold:
  - the unit is not used
  - the unit is not a conflict
  - the unit is not a thread
formula: all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict and u not in Thread) implies u in Orphaning
answer: all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict and u not in Thread) implies u in Orphaning

statement:
Checker reports the formula of a unit as lone on a signature when all of these hold:
  - the unit holds a formula
  - the unit is not a term
  - no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)
answer: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)

statement:
For every unit_1 and every word:
  when unit_1 declares the word and is not a term, the word is declared in a unit that is not a term.
formula: all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Introduce.rel and u not in Term) implies w in Misplaced
answer: (all v_1: Unit, v_2: Word | ((v_1->v_2 in Introduce.rel) and (not (v_1 in Term))) implies (v_2 in Misplaced))

statement:
All of these hold:
  - checker reports the formula of a unit as lone on a signature when all of these hold:
      - the unit holds a formula
      - the unit is not a term
      - no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit
  - for every unit and every word:
      when checker reports the formula of the unit as lone on the word, no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit.
formula: (all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)) and (all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged)
answer: ((all v_1: Unit | ((v_1 in Logical) and (not (v_1 in Term)) and (v_1 in Unchallenged)) implies ((some v_2: Signature | v_1->v_2 in Expose.rel)))) and ((all v_3: Unit, v_4: Word | (v_3->v_4 in Expose.rel) implies (v_3 in Unchallenged)))

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  when pass_1 puts a time phrase in front of the words it covers and pass_2 says a few clauses as one sentence, pass_1 runs before pass_2.
formula: all a: TimePhraseInFront, b: ClausesInASentence | a->b in ahead
answer: (all v_1: Pass, v_2: Pass | ((v_1 in TimePhraseInFront) and (v_2 in ClausesInASentence)) implies (v_1->v_2 in ahead))

statement:
For every word_1:
  checker reports the word word_1 when at least one of these holds:
    - word_1 is said by a reading and declared by nothing
    - word_1 is declared in a unit that is not a term
    - the reading of word_1 is in another unit than its declaration
    - no claim, definition or fact uses word_1
formula: all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged
answer: (all v_1: Word | ((v_1 in Undeclared) or (v_1 in Misplaced) or (v_1 in Apart) or (v_1 in Unused)) implies (v_1 in Flagged))

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2, every unit_1, every unit_2 and every word:
  checker does not report the formula of unit_1 as lone on the word when all of these hold:
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_1 holds unit_1
    - document_2 holds unit_2
    - a block of unit_2 names the word outside its declaration
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (d->e in Context.rel and d->u in Hold.units and e->v in Hold.units and v->w in Utter.rel) implies u->w not in Expose.rel
answer: (all v_1: Document, v_2: Document, v_3: Unit, v_4: Unit, v_5: Word | ((v_1->v_2 in Context.rel) and (v_1->v_3 in Hold.units) and (v_2->v_4 in Hold.units) and (v_4->v_5 in Utter.rel)) implies (not (v_3->v_5 in Expose.rel)))

statement:
Verbalizer says the second side of a list before its first side when all of these hold:
  - the list is a rule whose first side is a run of clauses said as bullets
  - the list is a rule whose second side is one line with no time phrase, relative clause, comma or "when"
  - the list is not a rule with an "otherwise"
formula: all f: Series | (f in ListFirstSide and f in PlainSecondSide and f not in Otherwise) implies f in SecondSideFirst
answer: (all v_1: Series | ((v_1 in ListFirstSide) and (v_1 in PlainSecondSide) and (not (v_1 in Otherwise))) implies (v_1 in SecondSideFirst))

statement:
For every plugin, every document and every listing frontmatter:
  when the document starts with the listing frontmatter and the listing frontmatter lists the plugin, checker runs the plugin over the document.
formula: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and lists[f, p]) implies p->d in Over.rel
answer: (all v_1: Plugin, v_2: Document, v_3: Listing | ((v_2->v_3 in Head.rel) and (lists[v_3, v_1])) implies (v_1->v_2 in Over.rel))

statement: When the statement of a unit is current, checker does not write the statement of the unit when it generates.
formula: all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Rewritten
answer: (all v_1: Unit | (v_1 in Current) implies (not (v_1 in Rewritten)))

statement:
Verbalizer says a list as bullets when all of these hold:
  - the list has an item that holds a comma
  - the list has more than two clauses
formula: all f: Series | (f in CommaItem and f in MoreThanTwo) implies f in AsBullets
answer: (all v_1: Series | ((v_1 in CommaItem) and (v_1 in MoreThanTwo)) implies (v_1 in AsBullets))

statement:
The checker cannot read a frontmatter when at least one of these holds:
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of an entry that starts with an at sign outside quotes
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a key that neither the checker nor a plugin that the frontmatter lists defines
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a list that is not closed
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a string that is not closed
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a key that appears twice
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a path that names no document
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of an extension that leads back to its own document
  - the frontmatter has the flaw of a setting in a document that is not the entry document
formula: all f: Frontmatter | (f in Misquoted or f in Foreign or f in Unclosed or f in Unterminated or f in Doubled or f in Dangling or f in Looping or f in Stray) implies f in Refused
answer: (all v_1: Frontmatter | ((v_1 in Misquoted) or (v_1 in Foreign) or (v_1 in Unclosed) or (v_1 in Unterminated) or (v_1 in Doubled) or (v_1 in Dangling) or (v_1 in Looping) or (v_1 in Stray)) implies (v_1 in Refused))

statement:
For every fence and every unit:
  when the fence names a language and lies in the own text of the unit, checker reads the fence as a block of the unit.
formula: all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel
answer: (all v_1: Fence, v_2: Unit | ((v_1 in Languaged) and (v_1->v_2 in Within.rel)) implies (v_2->v_1 in Blocks.rel))

statement:
For every unit_1 and every unit_2:
  checker names unit_2 in its report of a contradiction when all of these hold:
    - unit_1 is held with units that cannot all hold
    - the analyzer is asked about unit_1 together with unit_2
formula: all u: Unit, v: Unit | (u in Contradicting and u->v in Together.rel) implies v in Named
answer: (all v_1: Unit, v_2: Unit | ((v_1 in Contradicting) and (v_1->v_2 in Together.rel)) implies (v_2 in Named))

statement:
When a search leaves one unit out
then there is exactly one unit_1 such that all of these hold:
       - the search leaves out unit_1
       - the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of unit_1
       - the search does not require unit_1 to hold
       - for every unit_2:
           the search requires unit_2 to hold when all of these hold:
             - the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of unit_2
             - unit_2 and unit_1 are different
formula: all s: Search | s in Trial implies (one u: Unit | s->u in Leave.rel and u in Held and s->u not in Pose.units and (all v: Unit | (v in Held and v != u) implies s->v in Pose.units))
answer: (all v_1: Search | (v_1 in Trial) implies ((one v_2: Unit | (v_1->v_2 in Leave.rel) and (v_2 in Held) and (not (v_1->v_2 in Pose.units)) and ((all v_3: Unit | ((v_3 in Held) and (v_3 != v_2)) implies (v_1->v_3 in Pose.units))))))

statement:
For every plugin, every document and every listing frontmatter:
  checker does not run the plugin over the document when all of these hold:
    - the document starts with the listing frontmatter
    - the listing frontmatter does not list the plugin
    - the command line of no run names the document
formula: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and not lists[f, p] and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
answer: (all v_1: Plugin, v_2: Document, v_3: Listing | ((v_2->v_3 in Head.rel) and (not (lists[v_3, v_1])) and (not (v_2 in Given))) implies (not (v_1->v_2 in Over.rel)))

statement:
For every plugin, every document and every listing frontmatter:
  checker does not run the plugin over the document when all of these hold:
    - the document starts with the listing frontmatter
    - the listing frontmatter holds no entry
    - the command line of no run names the document
formula: all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel) and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
answer: (all v_1: Plugin, v_2: Document, v_3: Listing | ((v_2->v_3 in Head.rel) and ((no v_4: Entry | v_3->v_4 in Item.rel)) and (not (v_2 in Given))) implies (not (v_1->v_2 in Over.rel)))

statement:
All of these hold:
  - when the verbalizer fails on the formula of a unit with a fault of its own, checker does not say why the formula of the unit cannot be said
  - for every run, every command_1 and every unit:
      the run does not exit with code 0 when all of these hold:
        - the run asks for command_1
        - command_1 is the command `generate` or is the command `check`
        - the verbalizer fails on the formula of the unit with a fault of its own
formula: (all u: Unit | u in Faulted implies u not in Explained) and (all r: Run, c: Command, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and (c in GenerateCommand or c in CheckCommand) and u in Faulted) implies r not in Exits0)
answer: ((all v_1: Unit | (v_1 in Faulted) implies (not (v_1 in Explained)))) and ((all v_2: Run, v_3: Command, v_4: Unit | ((v_2->v_3 in Ask.rel) and ((v_3 in GenerateCommand) or (v_3 in CheckCommand)) and (v_4 in Faulted)) implies (not (v_2 in Exits0))))

statement: When a definition has an alternative that says something about another unit, verbalizer says the definition as a list of the alternatives as they stand.
formula: all f: Definition | f in NotAboutSubject implies f in AsItStands
answer: (all v_1: Definition | (v_1 in NotAboutSubject) implies (v_1 in AsItStands))

statement:
For every unit:
  all of these hold:
    - the statement of the unit is current when all of these hold:
        - the unit holds a formula
        - the statement of the unit sits between the markers of a generated region
        - the statement of the unit does not differ from what its formula says
        - the formula of the unit can be said in words
        - the statement of the unit reads back as its formula alone
    - when the unit holds no formula, the statement of the unit is not current
formula: all u: Unit | ((u in Logical and u in Generated and u not in Differs and u not in Unsayable and u not in Misread) implies u in Current) and (u not in Logical implies u not in Current)
answer: (all v_1: Unit | (((v_1 in Logical) and (v_1 in Generated) and (not (v_1 in Differs)) and (not (v_1 in Unsayable)) and (not (v_1 in Misread))) implies (v_1 in Current)) and ((not (v_1 in Logical)) implies (not (v_1 in Current))))

statement:
For every run and every logic command:
  the run exits with code 0 when all of these hold:
    - the run asks for the logic command
    - there is no scenario such that checker reports that the scenario cannot happen
    - no unit is held with units that cannot all hold
formula: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and (no x: Scenario | x in Raised) and (no u: Unit | u in Contradicting)) implies r in Exits0
answer: (all v_1: Run, v_2: LogicCommand | ((v_1->v_2 in Ask.rel) and ((no v_3: Scenario | v_3 in Raised)) and ((no v_4: Unit | v_4 in Contradicting))) implies (v_1 in Exits0))

statement:
For every document and every unit:
  checker reports the statement of the unit when all of these hold:
    - the document keeps readings
    - the document holds the unit
    - the unit holds a formula
    - the statement of the unit is not current
formula: all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
answer: (all v_1: Document, v_2: Unit | ((v_1 in Worded) and (v_1->v_2 in Hold.units) and (v_2 in Logical) and (not (v_2 in Current))) implies (v_2 in Reported))

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  pass_1 runs before pass_2 when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says until and since of two clauses as one sentence
    - pass_2 puts a time phrase in front of the words it covers
formula: all a: UntilInASentence, b: TimePhraseInFront | a->b in ahead
answer: (all v_1: Pass, v_2: Pass | ((v_1 in UntilInASentence) and (v_2 in TimePhraseInFront)) implies (v_1->v_2 in ahead))

statement:
For every run, every generate command and every unit:
  when the run asks for the generate command and the statement of the unit is handwritten, checker reports the statement of the unit and the run does not exit with code 0.
formula: all r: Run, c: GenerateCommand, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and u in Handwritten) implies (u in Reported and r not in Exits0)
answer: (all v_1: Run, v_2: GenerateCommand, v_3: Unit | ((v_1->v_2 in Ask.rel) and (v_3 in Handwritten)) implies ((v_3 in Reported) and (not (v_1 in Exits0))))

statement:
For every run:
  all of these hold:
    - when the run gets code 2 from a plugin, the run exits with code 2
    - the run exits with code 1 when all of these hold:
        - the run gets code 1 from a plugin
        - the run gets code 2 from no plugin
        - checker does not stop the run itself
formula: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2) and (((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1)
answer: (all v_1: Run | (((some v_2: Plugin | v_1->v_2 in Return.code2)) implies (v_1 in Exits2)) and ((((some v_3: Plugin | v_1->v_3 in Return.code1)) and ((no v_4: Plugin | v_1->v_4 in Return.code2)) and (not (stopped[v_1]))) implies (v_1 in Exits1)))

statement:
Verbalizer says a list without "then" when all of these hold:
  - the list is a rule whose two sides are each one clause
  - the list is not a rule whose first side begins with a time phrase
  - the list is not a rule whose second side begins with a time phrase
formula: all f: Series | (f in OneLineRule and f not in TimeFirst and f not in TimeSecond) implies f in DropsThen
answer: (all v_1: Series | ((v_1 in OneLineRule) and (not (v_1 in TimeFirst)) and (not (v_1 in TimeSecond))) implies (v_1 in DropsThen))

statement:
For every unit_1 and every unit_2:
  when unit_1 shares a word with unit_2, the analyzer is asked about unit_1 together with unit_2.
formula: all u: Unit, v: Unit | u->v in Share.rel implies u->v in Together.rel
answer: (all v_1: Unit, v_2: Unit | (v_1->v_2 in Share.rel) implies (v_1->v_2 in Together.rel))

statement:
A run exits with code 2 when at least one of these holds:
  - there is a frontmatter that lists a missing plugin
  - there is a document such that checker reports that the document has a frontmatter it cannot read
  - the run asks for a command that is not available
  - the run gets code 2 from a plugin
formula: all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
answer: (all v_1: Run | (((some v_2: Frontmatter | (some v_3: Missing | lists[v_2, v_3]))) or ((some v_4: Document | v_4 in Unreadable)) or ((some v_5: Command | (not (available[v_5])) and (v_1->v_5 in Ask.rel))) or ((some v_6: Plugin | v_1->v_6 in Return.code2))) implies (v_1 in Exits2))

statement:
For every run and every command_1:
  when the run asks for command_1 and command_1 is not available, checker reports command_1 as an unknown command.
formula: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown
answer: (all v_1: Run, v_2: Command | ((v_1->v_2 in Ask.rel) and (not (available[v_2]))) implies (v_2 in Unknown))

statement:
Verbalizer says a list with "then" before the time phrase when all of these hold:
  - the list is a rule whose two sides are each one clause
  - the list is not a rule whose first side begins with a time phrase
  - the list is a rule whose second side begins with a time phrase
formula: all f: Series | (f in OneLineRule and f not in TimeFirst and f in TimeSecond) implies f in KeepsThen
answer: (all v_1: Series | ((v_1 in OneLineRule) and (not (v_1 in TimeFirst)) and (v_1 in TimeSecond)) implies (v_1 in KeepsThen))

statement:
A run exits with code 1 when all of these hold:
  - the run gets code 1 from a plugin
  - the run gets code 2 from no plugin
  - checker does not stop the run itself
formula: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1
answer: (all v_1: Run | (((some v_2: Plugin | v_1->v_2 in Return.code1)) and ((no v_3: Plugin | v_1->v_3 in Return.code2)) and (not (stopped[v_1]))) implies (v_1 in Exits1))

statement:
For every word_1:
  checker does not report the word word_1 when all of these hold:
    - word_1 is said by no reading or is declared
    - word_1 is not declared in a unit that is not a term
    - the reading of word_1 is in the unit of its declaration
    - a claim, a definition or a fact uses word_1
formula: all w: Word | (w not in Undeclared and w not in Misplaced and w not in Apart and w not in Unused) implies w not in Flagged
answer: (all v_1: Word | ((not (v_1 in Undeclared)) and (not (v_1 in Misplaced)) and (not (v_1 in Apart)) and (not (v_1 in Unused))) implies (not (v_1 in Flagged)))

statement: When a list is longer than a line when it is put in a sentence, verbalizer says the list as bullets.
formula: all f: Series | f in TooLong implies f in AsBullets
answer: (all v_1: Series | (v_1 in TooLong) implies (v_1 in AsBullets))

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  pass_1 runs before pass_2 when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a set equal to a variable as that variable and no other
    - pass_2 makes nested quantifiers of "for every" one
formula: all a: XAndNoOther, b: ForEveryTogether | a->b in ahead
answer: (all v_1: Pass, v_2: Pass | ((v_1 in XAndNoOther) and (v_2 in ForEveryTogether)) implies (v_1->v_2 in ahead))

statement: When project has a tracker and a bug names no issue, checker reports an untracking for the bug.
formula: all b: Bug | (some Tracker and (no i: Issue | b->i in Name.issue)) implies b in Untracking
answer: (all v_1: Bug | ((some Tracker) and ((no v_4: Issue | v_1->v_4 in Name.issue))) implies (v_1 in Untracking))

statement:
The statement of a unit is handwritten when all of these hold:
  - the unit holds a formula
  - the unit has a statement
  - the statement of the unit does not sit between the markers of a generated region
  - the formula of the unit can be said in words
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Stated and u not in Generated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Handwritten
answer: (all v_1: Unit | ((v_1 in Logical) and (v_1 in Stated) and (not (v_1 in Generated)) and (not (v_1 in Unsayable))) implies (v_1 in Handwritten))

statement: When a fence names a language and has no second word that names a role, the fence has the role of the formula of its unit.
formula: all f: Fence | (f in Languaged and f in NoSecondWord) implies f in UnitBlock
answer: (all v_1: Fence | ((v_1 in Languaged) and (v_1 in NoSecondWord)) implies (v_1 in UnitBlock))

statement:
The formula of a unit cannot be said in words when at least one of these holds:
  - the formula of the unit names a word that has no reading
  - the unit holds more than one formula
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) implies u in Unsayable
answer: (all v_1: Unit | ((v_1 in Wordless) or (v_1 in Twofold)) implies (v_1 in Unsayable))

statement:
For every pass_1 and every pass_2:
  pass_1 runs before pass_2 when all of these hold:
    - pass_1 says a rule at every later moment as "from now on, whenever"
    - pass_2 says the second side of a rule before its first side
formula: all a: FromNowOnWhenever, b: ClaimFirst | a->b in ahead
answer: (all v_1: Pass, v_2: Pass | ((v_1 in FromNowOnWhenever) and (v_2 in ClaimFirst)) implies (v_1->v_2 in ahead))

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2 and every unit:
  the analyzer is asked to hold the formula of the unit when all of these hold:
    - the project lists document_1 among the documents it checks
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_2 holds the unit
    - the unit holds a formula with no keyword
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit | (d in Checked and d->e in Context.rel and e->u in Hold.units and u in BareFormula) implies u in Held
answer: (all v_1: Document, v_2: Document, v_3: Unit | ((v_1 in Checked) and (v_1->v_2 in Context.rel) and (v_2->v_3 in Hold.units) and (v_3 in BareFormula)) implies (v_3 in Held))

statement:
For every document_1, every document_2, every unit_1, every unit_2 and every word:
  the word is said by no reading or is declared when all of these hold:
    - document_2 is context for document_1
    - document_1 holds unit_1
    - a reading in unit_1 says the word
    - document_2 holds unit_2
    - unit_2 declares the word
formula: all d: Document, e: Document, u: Unit, v: Unit, w: Word | (d->e in Context.rel and d->u in Hold.units and u->w in Voice.rel and e->v in Hold.units and v->w in Introduce.rel) implies w not in Undeclared
answer: (all v_1: Document, v_2: Document, v_3: Unit, v_4: Unit, v_5: Word | ((v_1->v_2 in Context.rel) and (v_1->v_3 in Hold.units) and (v_3->v_5 in Voice.rel) and (v_2->v_4 in Hold.units) and (v_4->v_5 in Introduce.rel)) implies (not (v_5 in Undeclared)))

statement:
The statement of a unit is unwritten when all of these hold:
  - the unit holds a formula
  - the unit has no statement
  - the formula of the unit can be said in words
formula: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Stated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Unwritten
answer: (all v_1: Unit | ((v_1 in Logical) and (not (v_1 in Stated)) and (not (v_1 in Unsayable))) implies (v_1 in Unwritten))

statement:
A run exits with code 0 when all of these hold:
  - there is no plugin such that the run gets code 1 from the plugin or gets code 2 from the plugin
  - checker does not stop the run itself
formula: all r: Run | ((no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1 or r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits0
answer: (all v_1: Run | (((no v_2: Plugin | (v_1->v_2 in Return.code1) or (v_1->v_2 in Return.code2))) and (not (stopped[v_1]))) implies (v_1 in Exits0))

statement:
For every run and every logic command:
  the run does not exit with code 0 when all of these hold:
    - the run asks for the logic command
    - at least one of these holds:
        - there is a scenario such that checker reports that the scenario cannot happen
